description: This file sets up an Axios API client for a frontend application. It configures the base URL dynamically based on environment variables, includes request and response interceptors for adding auth tokens and handling errors, and exports the configured client for use in making API requests.

methods.name: request interceptor
methods.description: Intercepts outgoing requests to add authentication token and logs request details during development.

methods.name: response interceptor
methods.description: Handles incoming responses, logs responses during development, and manages errors globally.
